PROP-e5782b58-asm-005.text: Server actions must not return Discord UIDs or PII of other users in responses to non-admin callers.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-005.assertion: forall server_action_response(user, data): user.is_admin == false => no other_user.discord_id in data

locations.note: Returns discord_id in the userinfo response (line 38) to any caller with a valid access token. The token is self-issued (sub == caller), so discord_id returned is the caller's own — no cross-user PII leak here.
Access token payload includes discord_id (line 141) of the authenticated user. Non-admin users only get their own discord_id embedded in their token.
